progress.command:
git commit -q -F - <<'EOF' 2>&1 | grep -E 'Failed|✖' ; git push -q 2>&1; git log --oneline -2
fix: keep the index mtime in working-tree snapshots

captureState copied the index to a temporary file with a new mtime. Git
then trusted the cached stat of a file changed in the same clock tick as
the last index write, with the same size, so the snapshot missed the
change (racy git). This made a WorktreeContinuity test flaky in CI.
EOF
